extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether funding of £40,000 could be provided for a client's financial remedy case at the Central Family Court where the only asset is a flat with about £38,000 equity.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To consider it further we will need the date of the next hearing or listing, confirmation of the current stage of proceedings, and details of the client's circumstances and any other known assets or liabilities. It would also help to have evidence of the flat's value and any charges secured against it, together with an estimate of costs through to final hearing. We make no commitment at this stage; a member of the team will be in touch once the information has been reviewed.
